ops.find: South African Government said on X that asylum seekers and refugees are not allowed to vote

event.label: alleged
event.text: The South African Government said on X, on local-election day, that asylum seekers and refugees may not vote. Its graphics cite the Refugee Regulations, which it says bar them from political activity, and the Electoral Act, which it says limits voting to registered citizens aged 18 or over.
